dimensions.description: Presence and position of a recognized content-unit word.
Casing of the TV initialism, when present.
& vs and, when a coordinating connective is present.
Presence of a corpus-approved mood word (5.5/6).
Who is named, and whether it leads or trails a for-phrase.
Mechanical rhyme/alliteration and signed semantic reads.

method: Every row is a pure function of shelves.json and moves.json: no hand-picked lane list or unmarked extra vocabulary. Casing, unit position, TV casing, and the connective reuse the six already-measured grammar rules. Genre families and new mood words are discovered by subtracting every already-known class (unit, audience, origin, era, brand, curation, availability, stopwords, opening verbs) from each name and classifying what's left, once, by a human, in derive_corpus.py's TOKEN_CLASSIFICATION table. Twenty-three mood words inherited from the earlier analysis are explicitly marked seeded there; every other entry is marked discovered and must have current discovery evidence. Mechanical wordplay is adjacent-token rhyme/alliteration over the same leftover words. Semantic wordplay is never detected — only the 12+ signed readings in moves.json count.
